companions.hint: One entry per companion, each with its own dusha server and AstrBot platform or config profile. The first entry that matches a chat serves it.

label.hint: Never sent to the server and never affects routing. Use it to tell companions apart.

gateway_url.hint: One server per companion, each with its own home and port.

platform_id.hint: Run /sid on the selected bot and copy its Bot ID. Empty matches every platform when a config profile is set.

config_profile.hint: Profile ID or name allowed to use this companion. Empty matches every profile. Leave both this and platform ID empty to disable this companion.

harness.hint: Keys stored conversations and proactive events on the server. Keep it unique per companion. After a rename, queued events under the old name are orphaned.

api_token.hint: Sent as X-Companion-Token. Required when the server has auth turned on.

poll_interval_seconds.hint: How often to ask the server for proactive events. Values below 5 clamp to 5.

proactive_enabled.hint: Turn off to pause this companion without deleting it.

request_timeout_seconds.hint: How long to wait for one server response. Values below 1 clamp to 1.
